title: A Minimax Optimal Leave One Out Bound for Bounded Losses
abstract: arXiv:2611.31972v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study proper leave-one-out prediction with $M$ real-valued experts on $n$ fixed inputs. Each label is hidden in turn, and the learner uses the remaining labels to choose one of the experts' predictions at the held-out input. We determine how closely such a rule can match the average loss of the best single expert on the full sample. For any bounded loss that is a continuous nondecreasing function of absolute error and vanishes at zero, let $B$ denote its maximum value. Over classes of size $M$ and samples on which the best expert has average loss at most $r$, the minimax excess loss is of order $\min\{B, \sqrt{\frac{Br\log M}{n}}+\frac{B\log M}{n}\}$. For each class and loss, one deterministic rule attains this rate for every $r\in[0,B]$. The matching lower bound holds even for randomized proper rules given $r$.

translated_title: 有界损失下留一法的极小极大最优界
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在 $n$ 个固定输入点上、由 $M$ 个实值专家进行的适当留一预测问题。每个标签依次被隐藏，学习器利用其余标签在留出的输入点上选择某位专家的预测。我们确定了这类规则能够多好地匹配最佳单个专家在整个样本上的平均损失。对于任何有界损失——即关于绝对误差连续、非递减且在零点取值为零的函数——设其最大值为 $B$。在专家数量为 $M$、最佳专家平均损失至多为 $r$ 的样本类上，极小极大超额损失的阶为 $\min\{B, \sqrt{\frac{Br\log M}{n}}+\frac{B\log M}{n}\}$。对于每个专家类和每种损失，存在一个确定性规则对所有 $r\in[0,B]$ 都能达到该速率。相应的匹配下界即使在给定 $r$ 的随机适当规则下依然成立。
tldr: 本文针对有界损失下的留一预测问题给出了极小极大最优损失界，证明超额损失阶为 $\min\{B, \sqrt{Br\log M/n} + B\log M/n\}$，且单个确定性规则即可对所有 $r$ 达到该速率，并同时给出了匹配的下界。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a minimax optimal leave-one-out prediction bound for bounded losses, showing the excess loss is of order min{B, √(Br log M/n) + B log M/n}, achieved by a single deterministic rule for all r∈[0,B], with a matching lower bound that holds even for randomized proper rules.
